# Settings with one station counter on Press A (Station 1, id 51), every position countable.
## Settings › + Add station counter: Station 2 on S2.Count
  1  POST /api/processes/1/station-counters
       {
         "label": "Station 2",
         "tag_name": "S2.Count",
         "tag_name_2": ""
       }
  2  GET /api/processes/1/station-counters
  3  GET /api/process-nodes
  4  GET /api/processes/1/counting-slots
  5  GET /api/processes/1/catid-health
  6  GET /api/processes/1/countable
-- sheet closed

## Settings › Station 1 › Edit: Station 1b
  1  PUT /api/station-counters/51
       {
         "label": "Station 1b",
         "tag_name": "S1.Count",
         "tag_name_2": ""
       }
  2  GET /api/processes/1/station-counters
  3  GET /api/process-nodes
  4  GET /api/processes/1/counting-slots
  5  GET /api/processes/1/catid-health
  6  GET /api/processes/1/countable
-- sheet closed

## Settings › POS_A1 › Counted at: Station 1 (the select's change)
  1  PUT /api/process-nodes/201/counted-at
       {
         "line_counter_id": 51
       }
  2  GET /api/processes/1/station-counters
  3  GET /api/process-nodes
  4  GET /api/processes/1/counting-slots
  5  GET /api/processes/1/catid-health
  6  GET /api/processes/1/countable
-- sheet closed

## Settings › POS_A2 › Counted at: New station counter… (Station 3 on S3.Count, then the bind)
  1  POST /api/processes/1/station-counters
       {
         "label": "Station 3",
         "tag_name": "S3.Count",
         "tag_name_2": ""
       }
  2  PUT /api/process-nodes/202/counted-at
       {
         "line_counter_id": 52
       }
  3  GET /api/processes/1/station-counters
  4  GET /api/process-nodes
  5  GET /api/processes/1/counting-slots
  6  GET /api/processes/1/catid-health
  7  GET /api/processes/1/countable
-- sheet closed

## Settings › Station 1 › Change positions…: POS_A1 and POS_A2 ticked, the rest unticked, Save positions
  1  PUT /api/process-nodes/201/counted-at
       {
         "line_counter_id": 51
       }
  2  PUT /api/process-nodes/202/counted-at
       {
         "line_counter_id": 51
       }
  3  GET /api/processes/1/station-counters
  4  GET /api/process-nodes
  5  GET /api/processes/1/counting-slots
  6  GET /api/processes/1/catid-health
  7  GET /api/processes/1/countable
-- sheet closed

## Settings › Station 1 › Remove
  1  DELETE /api/station-counters/51
  2  GET /api/processes/1/station-counters
  3  GET /api/process-nodes
  4  GET /api/processes/1/counting-slots
  5  GET /api/processes/1/catid-health
  6  GET /api/processes/1/countable
-- sheet closed
